description: Safe baseline for an unknown Nintendo Switch game. Use a game-specific profile for autonomous play.
introduction: An unknown Nintendo Switch game. The system must observe the screen and avoid assuming game-specific rules.
objective: Observe the current screen and choose one safe, short action. If the game state or control meaning is unclear, wait.
state_notes: This is a generic Switch controller. A is usually confirm, B is usually back, and WAIT keeps all controls neutral. Do not assume game-specific rules.

controller.button_encoding: buttons is a simultaneous button list; left_stick and right_stick axes are normalized from -1 to 1; y=1 means up

A.how_to_press: 通常短按；只有画面要求持续动作时才按住
A.when_to_use: 画面明确提示确认、交互或主动作时

B.how_to_press: 通常短按；需要制动或持续动作时才按住
B.when_to_use: 画面明确提示返回、取消或次要动作时

X.meaning: 上下文或次级菜单动作

Y.meaning: 上下文动作或辅助功能

L.how_to_press: 短按或按住，取决于游戏提示

R.how_to_press: 短按或按住，取决于游戏提示

ZL.how_to_press: 短按或按住，取决于游戏提示

ZR.how_to_press: 短按或按住，取决于游戏提示

UP.how_to_press: 短按；可与其他按钮同时输入
UP.when_to_use: 菜单或游戏明确提示时

DOWN.how_to_press: 短按；可与其他按钮同时输入
DOWN.when_to_use: 菜单或游戏明确提示时

LEFT.how_to_press: 短按；可与其他按钮同时输入
LEFT.when_to_use: 菜单或游戏明确提示时

RIGHT.how_to_press: 短按；可与其他按钮同时输入
RIGHT.when_to_use: 菜单或游戏明确提示时

PLUS.when_to_use: 用户或游戏明确要求时

HOME.meaning: 返回 Switch 系统主页
HOME.when_to_use: 仅在明确要离开游戏时

CAPTURE.when_to_use: 仅在用户要求记录画面时

LEFT_STICK.how_to_press: x/y 均使用 -1 到 1；未确认映射时保持 0
LEFT_STICK.when_to_use: 观察到游戏需要移动、转向或选择时

RIGHT_STICK.how_to_press: x/y 均使用 -1 到 1；未确认映射时保持 0
RIGHT_STICK.when_to_use: 观察到游戏需要视角或相机动作时

WAIT.meaning: 释放所有输入并让摇杆回中
WAIT.when_to_use: 无法确认安全动作、菜单、加载或结果画面时

screen_state.meaning: 当前画面所属的游戏状态
screen_state.how_to_read: 先区分菜单、加载、实际游戏和结果画面，再决定输入

candidates.description: Keep the controller neutral and observe.
Press the primary confirm or interact button briefly.
Press the cancel or back button briefly.
